review_method: Preliminary visual review. Categories describe observable patterns, not proven causes. Multiple tags per image are permitted; labels are not independently verified.

definitions.pose_occlusion: Rotated or non-frontal face, hands/accessories covering cues, or lighting hiding part of the face.
definitions.subtle: Weak, mixed, or localized cues that make the four-category distinction difficult.
definitions.exaggerated: Strong open-mouth, crying, laughing, or other intense cues shared across categories.
definitions.low_quality: Blur, heavy grain, dark exposure, watermark, or low contrast obscures facial details.
definitions.label_doubtful: Dataset label is visually ambiguous; this flags uncertainty, not a verified labeling error.
